recommendation_summary: Action now: run a new cable to the desk computer, leave slack through the grommet so it isn't pinched, then place a test call. If the call holds, leave the network as it is. The reply adds no optional extras: the UniFi gateway, switches and Grafana dashboard are removed as current requirements. It does not cover what to do if the new cable doesn't fix the drops, and it doesn't address the future-proofing goal.
